raw.chosen: Implement sessionRef on current main (v0.2.28), not rebase of stale soc2-ra1/ra2 branches
raw.reasoning: Both soc2-ra1-grant-finalize and soc2-ra2-ledger are based on v0.2.26 — 4 commits behind main. They diverge from before #75/#76/#77 merged. Rebasing would require resolving substantial conflicts and would remove features (#76 lineage types). The net new value in both branches reduces to: (1) sessionRef field, (2) stricter CHECK constraints in ledger schema. Delivering (1) cleanly on main is faster, safer, and keeps CI green. (2) is a separate schema hardening that can follow if needed.
